snippet.title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2011 - Full Game Walkthrough (All Levels)
snippet.description: I will never forget coming home from elementary, after months of begging my parents for this game, and seeing the Dangerous Hunts 2011 Top Shot Elite Wii bundle waiting for me by the fireplace. I have a lot of nostalgia for this game, and I love replaying it every chance I get!
